description: Non-Identity predefined CMaps (here, the CID TrueType font 'HeiseiMin-W3' under the Shift-JIS-based predefined CMap '90ms-RKSJ-H') are a documented, diagnostic-only known gap in Phase 3 — Identity-H/V are the only predefined CMaps built in. The page mixes a plain-ASCII line ('Hello ASCII', Helvetica/WinAnsi, fully decodable) with a Japanese line ('日本語テスト', 90ms-RKSJ-H-encoded, NOT decodable in Phase 3). This fixture's assertion is intentionally narrower than the other fixtures: (a) extraction must complete without throwing (PdfOptions.Strict off), (b) the result's Diagnostics must contain a code in the knownFailure.diagnosticCodePrefix range, (c) expectedText's ASCII line is a SUBSTRING check against the page result, not a full-page equality check (the CJK run's exact fallback representation, e.g. omitted vs. U+FFFD-per-code, is an implementation choice deliberately left open).

oracle.method: poppler pdftotext (independent third-party extractor, never PlumePdf); pdffonts confirms the two fonts and 90ms-RKSJ-H encoding.
oracle.notes: pdffonts shows: 'Helvetica  Type 1  WinAnsi' and 'HeiseiMin-W3  CID TrueType  90ms-RKSJ-H'.

knownFailure.reason: 90ms-RKSJ-H is a non-Identity predefined CMap; Phase 3 ships Identity-H/V only and records a PLUME8xxx diagnostic for any other predefined CMap name, falling back for that font's runs rather than throwing (PdfOptions.Strict off).
